tool.PARTNER_FEATURE_OFF: the company has not turned on Send to partner for confirmation — ask the platform admin to enable it, then press Retry
tool.PARTNER_CHANNEL_OFF: the partner sending channel is not turned on in the system — tell the platform admin, then press Retry
tool.PARTNER_NEEDS_FILE: the contract has no file to send to the partner — upload one, then press Retry

outcome.expired: No reply from the partner — expired
outcome.failed: Could not send to the partner — needs attention

confirm.title: Partner confirmation of contracts
confirm.off: Off. The company cannot send or receive contracts with partners yet. Ask a platform admin to turn this on.
confirm.ready: On · ready to send and receive

app.ok: The company uses the Contracts book.
app.todo: The company has not turned on the Contracts book.

feature.ok: The feature is on for the company.
feature.todo: The feature is not on for the company.

channel.ok: The channel between companies is running.
channel.todo: The system has not turned on the channel between companies.

profile.ok: Legal name and tax code are set.
profile.todo: The company's legal name or tax code is missing.

listed.ok: The company can be found by other companies.
listed.todo: The company cannot be found yet. Turn it on in Admin › Profile › Company directory to receive contracts.

receive_flow.ok: There is a flow handling contracts partners send.
receive_flow.todo: No flow handles contracts partners send.

groups.ok: The confirming group on the receiving side has members.
groups.todo: The confirming group is missing or has no members. Add people so someone can confirm.
groups.unknown: Could not check the confirming group.

send_flow.ok: There is a flow that sends contracts to partners.
send_flow.todo: No flow has the "Send to partner for confirmation" step. Add it to the approval flow if the company needs to send.
send_flow.unknown: Could not check the sending flow.

settings.title: Contracts received from partners
settings.ownerNone: Not set — company admins handle them

issue.order: The “Critical” threshold must be higher than “Important”.

inbox.title: Contracts from partners
inbox.empty: No contracts have been sent to you by partners yet.
inbox.error: Could not load the inbox. Try reloading the page.

in.pending: Waiting for your company to confirm · due {{until}}
in.nextNone: {{sender}} was told · nothing more to do

out.title: Send to partner for confirmation
out.waitManual: Waiting for a manual record · {{to}} is not on the system
out.held: Waiting for the receiving company to agree to connect
out.heldWhy: First time sending to {{to}} · the contract arrives once they agree
out.heldNext: Nothing more to do · or send by email
out.heldExpired: The partner did not accept — expired
out.heldExpiredWhy: The receiving company did not agree to connect in time
out.nextRecord: Use “Record partner's answer” when they reply
out.nextFix: Fix the contract and send it again
out.nextStop: The process took the Declined branch

record.fail: Could not record it. Check the fields and try again.

need.byName: Enter who at the partner answered
need.evidence: Manual record needs at least one piece of evidence
